info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Mortgage Loans Apply-v3-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Application API facilitates the submission of mortgage loan applications, streamlining the process for both applicants and lending institutions. This endpoint allows users to provide necessary details to initiate the mortgage financing process. Typical consumers include mortgage brokers and financial institutions that use this API to enhance their client services. By enabling digital loan applications, this API improves efficiency and transparency in securing mortgage financing.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit an application for a loan. Provide the necessary applicant details and loan information to process the application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a loan application. It should include all necessary details such as applicant information, loan amount, and any relevant supporting documents. Ensure the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema.
